content.short: Mantle is a modular Ethereum L2 network using Optimistic Rollups and EigenDA for high-performance DeFi applications.
content.description: Mantle is a high-performance modular Ethereum Layer 2 network, designed to provide a scalable and cost-effective environment for decentralized applications. By utilizing Optimistic Rollups and being the first to adopt EigenDA for modular data availability, Mantle achieves high throughput and sub-second finality while inheriting the robust security of the Ethereum mainnet. The network is powered by the $MNT token, which facilitates transaction fees, staking, and decentralized governance. Positioned as a "banking blockchain," Mantle aims to bridge the gap between Traditional Finance and the decentralized economy through institutional infrastructure.
